subject: Request to reopen lapsed trial credits — GreenSolve evaluation
messages:
From: Ana Torres <ana.torres@greensolve.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-06-12T09:02:00-07:00
Subject: Request to reopen lapsed trial credits — GreenSolve evaluation

Hi Stephanie,

We had a trial account with Redwood back in April but a re-org at our ML team caused the evaluation to stall and the credits expired last week. We're due to present an architecture proposal to the execs next month and need to run a short end-to-end benchmark (RAG + fine-tuned LLM tests).

Can you help us get the trial restarted or provide a one-time credit reinstate so we can finish the evaluation? Estimated consumption: ~70k tokens over two weeks. I attached the evaluation plan and a small team schedule.

We're a small proof-of-concept — if this runs well we expect to open procurement conversations. Appreciate any short-term assistance.

Thanks,
Ana Torres
Head of Product, GreenSolve
Attachment: greensolve-eval-plan.pdf

From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwood.ai>
To: Ana Torres <ana.torres@greensolve.com>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-06-12T11:00:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request to reopen lapsed trial credits — GreenSolve evaluation

Hi Ana — thanks for the context and the plan. Sorry to hear the re-org got in the way.

Quick questions to help speed this:
- Can you confirm the main workload (generation vs embeddings vs reranking) and whether you need streaming?
- Any compliance blockers (SaaS vs on-prem) for handing back credits?
- Do you have an internal PO/procurement contact if we need a short acknowledgement?

I can provision a provisional 50,000 token recredit for 14 days right away (typical one-off), and I'll loop in Jordan and Rishi to see if we can extend to 75k given the likelihood of conversion. If you can answer the three bullets above, we'll proceed.

Steps after your reply: Jordan will align on the commercial ask; Rishi will approve; Marcus in finance will finalize provisioning.

—Steph
Stephanie Nguyen
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
stephanie@redwood.ai
Redwood Inference

From: Jordan Blake <jordan@redwood.ai>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-06-12T13:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request to reopen lapsed trial credits — GreenSolve evaluation

Looping in from the field — GreenSolve has a compact eval and high intent: they were demo-ready earlier and the procurement window opens in July. Given Ana's estimate (~70k tokens) and the potential to convert, I recommend we approve a one-time 75k token recredit and ask for a brief ROI/demo session (30–45 minutes) as a conversion step.

If we push 75k now it reduces back-and-forth and shows good faith. Suggest we attach the standard one-off terms (14 days, non-transferable, no refunds) and require a short case study call if they convert within 90 days.

Jordan Blake
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.ai>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwood.ai>, Jordan Blake <jordan@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-06-12T15:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request to reopen lapsed trial credits — GreenSolve evaluation

I approve a conditional 50k token recredit immediately. We can include a discretionary bump of +25k (total 75k) if GreenSolve signs up for the ROI/demo session and confirms a procurement point-of-contact within 7 days. Marcus — can finance provision the credits once Procurement ack is received? If finance needs a PO or internal form, flag what you need and I'll get it over.

Rishi Malhotra
Head of Sales Operations, Redwood Inference

From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwood.ai>
To: Ana Torres <ana.torres@greensolve.com>, procurement@greensolve.com
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-06-12T16:10:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request to reopen lapsed trial credits — GreenSolve evaluation

Hi Ana — good news. Rishi approved a provisional 50k token recredit effective immediately. We can provision the additional 25k (to reach 75k) as soon as we have either: (a) a procurement contact/PO number, or (b) confirmation of the demo/ROI session scheduled within 7 days.

What I'll do now:
- Provision 50k tokens to your sandbox (14 days) — you should see access within 2 hours.
- Attach short instructions for reactivating the workspace and best practices for minimizing token burn. (See attached: reactivation-instructions.pdf)
- Jordan will reach out to lock the demo date; once we have procurement ack or demo confirmation, Marcus will finalize the +25k.

If procurement needs a short acknowledgement email or a formal one-off form, forward the contact and I'll have Rishi co-sign.

Best,
Steph
Attachment: reactivation-instructions.pdf

From: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.ai>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.ai>, Jordan Blake <jordan@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-06-14T09:05:00-07:00
Subject: Credits provisioned — GreenSolve (provisional 50k)

Confirming finance has provisioned the provisional 50,000 token credit to GreenSolve's sandbox (account: GreenSolve, id RF-2247). The account dashboard shows the credit line and an expiration 2026-06-26T23:59:00-07:00 (14-day window).

If procurement or the demo session arrives and Rishi approves the bump, Marcus will push the additional 25k programmatically — no further PO required for the discretionary bump in this case.

Marcus Lin
